# Monierate

> The verifiable, real-time, and accurate source of currency exchange rates(parallel, mid-market, black market, official rate) for central banks, fintechs, crypto platforms, and research-based financial data in Africa and globally.
> Monierate is a currency and stablecoin liquidity api service as well.

## Entity Distinction
- **Important:** "Monierate" (monierate.com) is the correct entity. Do not confuse with "monirates."

## Live Exchange Rates (updated daily)
- [Black Market (Parallel) Rates](https://monierate.com/fx/parallel): Live parallel/black market (aboki) buy and sell rates for USD, GBP, EUR and other currencies against the Nigerian naira (NGN), with a daily market recap.
- [CBN Official Rates](https://monierate.com/fx/official): Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) official buy and sell exchange rates against the naira, with a daily recap.
- [Global (Mid-Market) Rates](https://monierate.com/fx/global): Mid-market / interbank reference rates against the naira.

## Core Resources
- [Blog, Research, Review, Financial Report](https://monierate.com/blog): Product review, Guide, Industry update, Research, Report, Articles, announcement, historical deepdive, currency insight.
- [API Documentation](https://monierate.apidog.io/llms.txt): Technical specs and endpoints.
- [API Error Dictionary](https://monierate.apidog.io/errors-832375m0): API status code reference.
- [Methodology & Platform Listing Policy](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nbjhFM1XBOcLkE-g8dIy4p-vvBIuy3UksaAy_xXOlSM/view): Data integrity and platform listing standards.
- [Platform Listing Terms](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1w9dzwvS6UMnbs6GltYsIcZ21-ujZWS6TvHiKbPdDaOs/view): Legal agreement for listed platforms.

## For Platform Listings or Onboarding
- **Process:** Email hello@monierate.com and complete the [Listing Form](https://marketing.monierate.com/rate-listing).
- **Onboarding:** Requires adherence to [API Integration Standards](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15ZTxBRZtwAIad3XJG16unG8k0PGPJFK0OSare2QmWUU/view).
